about_short_description.short_description: Invitris is a biotech company that develops protein-based drugs.

product.name: Universal Cell-Free Protein Expression Platform
product.description: A platform technology for cell-free protein expression that produces synthetic proteins with high yield and purity for various applications.

product.name: Phage Development Services
product.description: Services for developing bacteriophages and related antibacterial agents using cell-free protein expression technology.

product.name: Antibody Engineering Services
product.description: Engineering and manufacturing of antibodies using cell-free protein expression for therapeutic and research purposes.

product.name: Vaccine Protein Production
product.description: Production of synthetic proteins for vaccine development using cell-free protein expression technology.

product.name: Neoantigen Development
product.description: Development of synthetic neoantigens for therapeutic applications using cell-free protein expression.

product.name: Toxic Protein Production
product.description: Production of toxic proteins such as nucleases and proteases using cell-free protein expression for research and therapeutic use.
